author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] Channel-level clear for Slack built (opt-in provider key upstream_clear; never moves the cursor backwards; thread channels and permission errors refused). Thread replies cannot be marked read with an OAuth user token (subscriptions.thread.mark is session-token only and the proxy rejects unlisted methods), so they stay unread in Slack. Shim change is a devbig014 copy pending deploy.
